title: bromus patulus var. genuinus
intro: Bromus patulus var. genuinus, commonly known as 'genuinus', is a variant of the perennial grass species Bromus patulus. It is a type of plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Eastern Asia, for its various health benefits. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions like fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Bromus patulus var. genuinus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
